source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 7.1, PDF page 150 (printed p. 142)
about: Table 7.1, "Acoustic parameters for different materials": two rigid-frame materials the chapter uses to compare the exact reflected field of a point source with the passage path method (Figures 7.3 and 7.4 use material 1). Columns as printed: tortuosity, flow resistivity sigma (N m-4 s), porosity, viscous dimension Lambda (um) and thermal dimension Lambda' (um). The page names them Material 1 and Material 2 and says nothing about what they are, so nothing here does either: they are parameter sets for a computed example, not characterised specimens.
